purpose: Authoritative payment lifecycle and safety specification for Android implementation.

rules: UI must reflect the payment state; UI must not redefine payment truth.
No payment credential capture or storage.
Do not treat mobile-network availability as proof that a payment will succeed.

cellular_network.meaning: An available mobile network connection is required for payment communication.

payment_sim.rule: If multiple SIMs are available, the user must select the preferred payment SIM. If only one SIM is available, it may be selected automatically.

payment_access.meaning: Required payment-access/automation setup must be ready before attempting the payment flow.

camera.meaning: Camera access is required only for QR scanning.

state_definitions.IDLE: No payment is currently being attempted.
state_definitions.USSD_DETECTED: The payment interface has been detected and classified as an actionable USSD payment screen.
state_definitions.INPUT_ENTERED: The required non-sensitive payment input has been entered.
state_definitions.SUBMITTING: V4SH is submitting the current non-sensitive step to the payment interface.
state_definitions.WAITING_RESPONSE: V4SH is waiting for the next payment-interface response.
state_definitions.PROCESSING: A payment attempt may have been initiated and V4SH is waiting for definitive confirmation.
state_definitions.SUCCESS: Definitive payment confirmation has been received.
state_definitions.FAILED: The underlying payment attempt has definitively failed.
state_definitions.UNKNOWN: A payment may have been initiated, but V4SH cannot determine the final outcome.
state_definitions.CANCELLED: The user stopped the flow before payment initiation.

FAILED.retry_rule: Retry may be offered only when the failure is definitively known and retry is otherwise safe.

UNKNOWN.meaning: Payment status unclear; payment may already have been initiated.

CANCELLED.requires: User stopped the flow before payment initiation.
CANCELLED.important: Stopping V4SH after initiation must not be represented as cancellation of the bank/UPI transaction.

processing_rules.message: Payment is in progress. Waiting for payment confirmation. Please don't press Pay again or close the app.

user_stop_action.label: Stop waiting
user_stop_action.meaning: Stops V4SH from waiting on the current screen.
user_stop_action.does_not_mean: It does not cancel a payment that may already have been initiated.

do_not_auto_classify_as_failed: App leaving the processing screen without definitive bank/payment confirmation

no_mobile_network.message: V4SH needs a mobile network connection to communicate with the payment service.

network_loss_after_initiation.rule: Do not automatically mark the payment FAILED or CANCELLED.

qr_payment.supported_entry_principle: Scan standard UPI QR codes; V4SH does not require a proprietary V4SH QR.
qr_payment.rule: No payment is considered initiated merely because a QR code was scanned or recipient details were parsed.

ussd_automation.purpose: Automate only the non-sensitive navigation/input required by the proven payment path.
safety_rules: Never enter or automate a UPI PIN.
Never enter OTPs or other sensitive credentials.
Classify the current screen before acting.
Do not write arbitrary values into arbitrary editable fields.
Stop automation on PIN or sensitive screens.
Avoid repeated tree scans and unnecessary recursive accessibility traversal.

state_machine_boundary.before_sensitive_input: V4SH may automate the proven non-sensitive navigation steps.
state_machine_boundary.sensitive_step: The user must complete the sensitive authentication step through the appropriate system/payment interface; V4SH must not capture or inject the credential.

transaction_record.purpose: Maintain a local V4SH record of payments initiated through V4SH.

reference_id.rule: Show a reference ID only when one is actually available from the payment flow.

implementation_constraints: Do not build a wallet or internal V4SH balance.
Do not add merchant onboarding or merchant-side V4SH infrastructure.
Do not introduce a proprietary V4SH QR format.
Do not claim cancellation of an already initiated bank/UPI transaction.
Do not expose Retry Payment as the immediate action for UNKNOWN.
Do not mark UNKNOWN as FAILED without definitive evidence.
Do not mark a payment SUCCESS without definitive confirmation.
Do not store or transmit UPI PIN, OTP, bank passwords, card PINs, or CVV.
Do not fabricate transaction IDs or bank references.
